derivation: from G4253 (πρό) and G5143 (τρέχω) (including its alternate);
def: to run forward, i.e. outstrip, precede

occurrences.text: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
